'''''Escape''''' was the name for a pair of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] which were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shuttles were stationed on the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Frigate]] [[Huntress]] carrying [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. The ''Huntress'' participated in the [[Attacks on Platform NL-1|Second Battle of the Pakuuni system]]. When the frigate's shields were down the two shuttles launched out of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and were consequently shot down by [[Imperial Ace]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttles appear in mission three. They are to be destroyed as part of a bonus objective, which can only be achieved by draining the shields of the ''Huntress''.
